draft.title: Does this tiny perplexity test reveal anything meaningful about DeepSeek R1’s reasoning ability?
draft.body: A user shared a very short perplexity test on DeepSeek R1 models with different expert counts, plus some distilled models and Virtuoso-Medium-v2. Perplexity measures how well a model predicts text, but this test only ran on 8 blocks out of about 560 and used block size 512, so it’s far from comprehensive. The report also notes perplexity might not fairly assess chain-of-thought models since they don’t get to perform step-by-step reasoning in this setup. Interestingly, the full DeepSeek R1 (even quantized) seemed to outperform distills unless limited to 2 experts, with Virtuoso Medium V2 falling between 3 and 4 experts. Given these limits, can we really draw conclusions about DeepSeek’s actual reasoning skills from such a small perplexity test?
